name: Rusted Scavenger Drone
description: A pre-collapse delivery drone, still running its last route for a company that no longer exists.

name: Feral Street Sweeper
description: It cleaned these streets for forty years. Now it just circles, brushes worn to wire, cleaning nothing.

name: Signal Wraith
description: A knot of looping broadcasts given shape. It speaks in weather reports and station idents.

name: The Archivist
description: A server-array that refused to shut down, hoarding every file it could reach. It does not want to be read. It wants to keep.

name: Choir of Lights
description: The transit hub's emergency beacons, synchronized into something that sings. Beautiful, and it does not want you to leave.
